    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">DeepSeek V4，我在做项目和写软著材料时，顺手用了一段时间</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<section id="nice" data-tool="mdnice编辑器" data-website="https://www.mdnice.com" style="margin: 0; padding: 0 10px; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; font-family: Optima, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, PingFangSC-regular, serif; font-size: 16px; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); line-height: 1.5em; word-spacing: 0; letter-spacing: 0; overflow-wrap: break-word; text-align: left"><p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">前阵子 DeepSeek 更新到了 V4。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">一开始我其实没太当回事。现在大模型更新太快了，几乎隔一段时间就来一次“版本升级”，但很多时候用起来差别并不大。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">但这次比较巧。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">我刚好在做一个 Web 应用，还顺便在准备软著材料，这一阶段我基本是边开发边用了一下 DeepSeek V4。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">用下来两周，有一些比较具体的感受，想记录一下。</p>
<hr data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 10px 0; padding: 0; border-top: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-bottom: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-left: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-right: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: 1px">
<h1 data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 30px 0 15px; padding: 0; display: block"><span class="prefix" style="display: none"></span><span class="content" style="font-size: 24px; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); line-height: 1.5em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: bold; display: block">一、它给我的第一感觉：更“稳”了</span><span class="suffix" style="display: none"></span></h1>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">如果只说一个变化，那就是稳定性。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">以前用一些模型，经常会遇到这种情况：</p>
<ul data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="list-style-type: disc; margin: 8px 0; padding: 0 0 0 25px; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
<li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal">聊着聊着开始跑偏</section></li><li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal">上下文接不上</section></li><li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal">同一个问题，前后说法不一致</section></li></ul>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">V4 在这方面明显好很多。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">我在改接口的时候，有一段逻辑来回调整了好几次，它基本能记住前面的约束，不会每一轮都重新理解问题。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">这种体验不算惊艳，但很关键。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">因为开发过程中最怕的不是它不会，而是它前后不一致。</p>
<hr data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 10px 0; padding: 0; border-top: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-bottom: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-left: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-right: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: 1px">
<h1 data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 30px 0 15px; padding: 0; display: block"><span class="prefix" style="display: none"></span><span class="content" style="font-size: 24px; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); line-height: 1.5em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: bold; display: block">二、在项目里，它更像“辅助工具”，而不是“替代者”</span><span class="suffix" style="display: none"></span></h1>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">前段时间我做的这个 Web 应用，从接口到部分功能实现，其实都有用到它。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">但用下来有一个很清晰的感受：</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">它不是帮你“写完项目”的，而是帮你“推进过程”的。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">具体几个使用场景：</p>
<hr data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 10px 0; padding: 0; border-top: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-bottom: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-left: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-right: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: 1px">
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 30px 0 15px; padding: 0; display: block"><span class="prefix" style="display: none"></span><span class="content" style="font-size: 22px; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); line-height: 1.5em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: bold; display: block">1. 写接口和补逻辑</span><span class="suffix" style="display: none"></span></h2>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">有些基础接口，比如分页、条件查询这类，我会直接让它先给一个初版。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">它给出的代码：</p>
<ul data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="list-style-type: disc; margin: 8px 0; padding: 0 0 0 25px; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
<li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal">结构基本正确</section></li><li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal">命名还算正常</section></li><li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal">一些基础异常处理也会带上</section></li></ul>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">不是那种只能参考的代码，而是可以直接拿来改的。</p>
<hr data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 10px 0; padding: 0; border-top: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-bottom: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-left: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-right: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: 1px">
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 30px 0 15px; padding: 0; display: block"><span class="prefix" style="display: none"></span><span class="content" style="font-size: 22px; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); line-height: 1.5em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: bold; display: block">2. 查问题和定位 bug</span><span class="suffix" style="display: none"></span></h2>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">有些问题自己一时想不明白，会直接把代码丢进去，让它帮我分析。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">它不会一上来就改代码，而是会先列可能原因，再给修改建议。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">这一点其实挺像正常开发的思路。</p>
<hr data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 10px 0; padding: 0; border-top: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-bottom: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-left: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-right: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: 1px">
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 30px 0 15px; padding: 0; display: block"><span class="prefix" style="display: none"></span><span class="content" style="font-size: 22px; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); line-height: 1.5em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: bold; display: block">3. 顺带帮我处理了一部分软著材料</span><span class="suffix" style="display: none"></span></h2>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">在写软著说明文档的时候，有一些描述性内容，我也会让它帮我整理一下。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">比如：</p>
<ul data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="list-style-type: disc; margin: 8px 0; padding: 0 0 0 25px; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
<li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal">功能描述的表述</section></li><li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal">一些模块说明的梳理</section></li></ul>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">它在这种“半技术 + 半文字”的场景里，其实还挺好用的。</p>
<hr data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 10px 0; padding: 0; border-top: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-bottom: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-left: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-right: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: 1px">
<h1 data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 30px 0 15px; padding: 0; display: block"><span class="prefix" style="display: none"></span><span class="content" style="font-size: 24px; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); line-height: 1.5em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: bold; display: block">三、一个挺明显的短板：还停留在“文本世界”</span><span class="suffix" style="display: none"></span></h1>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">用了一段时间，有一个点其实挺明显的。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">就是它现在基本还是围绕“文本”在工作。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">我在做这个 Web 项目的时候，本来想过一件事：</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">把页面截图丢给它，让它帮我分析 UI，或者给一些交互建议。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">但这条路是走不通的。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">查了一下资料，也基本可以确认：</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">这一代 V4 还是预览版，多模态能力并没有真正上线。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">这在现在的大模型环境里，其实算是一个比较明显的短板。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">因为像现在一些主流模型，已经可以：</p>
<ul data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="list-style-type: disc; margin: 8px 0; padding: 0 0 0 25px; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
<li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal">直接看图</section></li><li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal">分析页面结构</section></li><li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal">甚至给出 UI 优化建议</section></li></ul>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">而 DeepSeek V4 更依赖你把问题“描述清楚”。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">这就导致一个很现实的差异：</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">在“写代码、写内容、做推理”这些事情上，它很好用；
但在“看界面、理解视觉信息”这类场景里，它暂时帮不上忙。</p>
<hr data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 10px 0; padding: 0; border-top: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-bottom: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-left: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-right: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: 1px">
<h1 data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 30px 0 15px; padding: 0; display: block"><span class="prefix" style="display: none"></span><span class="content" style="font-size: 24px; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); line-height: 1.5em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: bold; display: block">四、它也不是没有问题</span><span class="suffix" style="display: none"></span></h1>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">用下来，有些问题还是挺真实的。</p>
<hr data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 10px 0; padding: 0; border-top: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-bottom: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-left: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-right: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: 1px">
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 30px 0 15px; padding: 0; display: block"><span class="prefix" style="display: none"></span><span class="content" style="font-size: 22px; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); line-height: 1.5em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: bold; display: block">1. 还是会答错，而且有时候挺自信</span><span class="suffix" style="display: none"></span></h2>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">有些答案看起来很合理，但细节是错的。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">如果不自己判断，很容易被带偏。</p>
<hr data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 10px 0; padding: 0; border-top: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-bottom: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-left: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-right: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: 1px">
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 30px 0 15px; padding: 0; display: block"><span class="prefix" style="display: none"></span><span class="content" style="font-size: 22px; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); line-height: 1.5em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: bold; display: block">2. 对复杂系统支持有限</span><span class="suffix" style="display: none"></span></h2>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">小功能、小模块都没问题。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">但如果是复杂项目，比如多模块系统、历史逻辑很多的代码，它的理解能力还是不够。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">更多还是适合作为辅助，而不是主导。</p>
<hr data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 10px 0; padding: 0; border-top: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-bottom: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-left: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-right: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: 1px">
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 30px 0 15px; padding: 0; display: block"><span class="prefix" style="display: none"></span><span class="content" style="font-size: 22px; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); line-height: 1.5em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: bold; display: block">3. 偶尔会有“套路感”</span><span class="suffix" style="display: none"></span></h2>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">在生成内容的时候，有时候结构会比较标准化。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">如果不做调整，读起来会有点像模板。</p>
<hr data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 10px 0; padding: 0; border-top: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-bottom: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-left: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-right: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: 1px">
<h1 data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 30px 0 15px; padding: 0; display: block"><span class="prefix" style="display: none"></span><span class="content" style="font-size: 24px; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); line-height: 1.5em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: bold; display: block">五、一个比较实际的结论</span><span class="suffix" style="display: none"></span></h1>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">如果问我现在值不值得用。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">我的答案是：</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">可以用，而且已经可以作为开发过程中的一个常用工具。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">但前提是要有一个清晰的认知：</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">它更像一个能随时帮你补一把的工具，而不是替你完成工作的那个人。</p>
<hr data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 10px 0; padding: 0; border-top: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-bottom: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-left: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-right: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: 1px">
<h1 data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 30px 0 15px; padding: 0; display: block"><span class="prefix" style="display: none"></span><span class="content" style="font-size: 24px; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); line-height: 1.5em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: bold; display: block">六、也想听听你们怎么用</span><span class="suffix" style="display: none"></span></h1>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">现在大家用大模型的方式，其实差别挺大的。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">有人只是偶尔查资料，有人已经深度参与到开发流程里。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">我比较好奇的是：</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">你现在主要用它来做什么？
有没有真的提升效率？
有没有遇到过比较离谱的回答？</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">可以聊聊。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">不同人的用法，其实挺有参考价值的。</p>
</section>
